build_LSTMModel: build an LSTM encoder-decoder model for sequence-to-sequence machine translation using fairseq
build_LSTMEncoder: build an LSTM encoder with configurable embedding dimension, hidden size, and bidirectional layers
build_LSTMDecoder: build an LSTM decoder with attention mechanism and optional adaptive softmax output layer
build_AttentionLayer: build an attention layer that computes attention scores between decoder hidden state and encoder outputs
configure_base_architecture: configure the default LSTM model architecture with 512-dim embeddings and single encoder-decoder layers
